notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]We will proceed with the English version translation shortly. Thank you for your support![/p][p]Here are the main updates for version v1.1.5:  

### **New Features:**  
- Added attribute filtering for gems.  
- Added automatic selling based on item prefixes.  
- Added prefix filtering for equipment.  
- Added a cancel button for Daoist study.  
- Added display of critical rate and critical resistance in monster info.  
- Added random name change by clicking the character name in the role interface (manual renaming with word filtering still has issues after days of testing, so a random renaming alternative is temporarily used).  
- Completing Secret Realm cultivation now reduces the cooldown time for breakthrough failures (reduction time depends on sect level).  

### **Bug Fixes:**  
- Fixed an issue where BUFFs might not be removed correctly upon expiration.  
- Fixed a bug where the "Heavenly Demon" mode could not accumulate continuously upon initial activation.  

### **System Adjustments:**  
- Reduced upgrade/advancement time for the Heavenly Workshop.  
- Adjusted the maximum effective defense for martial skills/internal energy to 90%.  

### **Archive Backup:**  
If the game crashes or the process is terminated during saving, the archive may become corrupted. A backup system (`saves_backup`) has been added to prevent cloud save loss. If the archive is corrupted and the game cannot create a new save, you can:  
1. Enable Steam offline mode.  
2. Manually delete the corrupted save in the `saves` folder.  
3. Copy the backup save from `saves_backup` to `saves` to attempt recovery.  

**Save Location:** Press `Win + R`, enter `AppData`, then navigate to:  
`\\LocalLow\\skyblack games\\Timeless Teapot\\userData\\saves`  

If you encounter bugs or have questions, feel free to join our group (**361947533**) or email us at:  
[/p][p][url="https://**skyblack7301@gmail.com**"]**skyblack7301@gmail.com**[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 《壶中日月》正式版——壶中千年，今日飞升！
notes.notes: [h3]“等了九百七十二年，终于等到这一日……”[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45420082/2ed5b8912eb7c6ec28ea6a6cf9c458800a2e34e3.png"][/img]乾坤倒转，日月重光！《壶中日月》已结束千年闭关(抢先体验)，正式版破壶而出！[/p][h3]【壶中世界，终得圆满】[/h3][p]自抢先体验以来，承蒙千百道友点化（反馈）、渡劫（修BUG）、传道（安利），如今的《壶中日月》已脱胎换骨：[/p][p]宗门重建：从断壁残垣到琼楼玉宇，天工阁巧夺天工，聚灵台吞吐日月，天衍阵道演化周天，壶天赐福泽被众生，无间炼狱磨砺道心...一步一重天，终成洞天福地。[/p][p]真相揭晓：千年因果轮回现，炼器宗师的宿命、心魔之战的真相、赤璃器灵的前世今生...所有天机，今日大白。[/p][p]优化飞升：诸般业障（BUG）尽数镇压，修行之路如醍醐灌顶（流畅体验），纵是挂机清修，亦可证得无上大道！[/p][p][/p][h3]【道友之恩，壶灵铭记】[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45420082/e81de1fadb4416151e1355f209754e5af8f146f5.png"][/img][/p][p]“天道五十，遁去其一——而你们，正是那一线生机。”[/p][p]赤璃托我们向所有参与EA测试、在群内论道、的道友稽首致谢。是你们的每一句指导和反馈，让这方壶天从"芥子微尘"蜕变为"三千世界"。[/p][p][/p][h3]【正式版首发特惠】[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p]在《壶中日月》正式版上线时，游戏将开启两周九折优惠（7.23-8.6），购买仅需16.2元。[/p][p]正式版不加价！相比于半年前EA版本，游戏功能体验更加丰富完整，严重BUG都已解决。本作乃独立开发的首次尝试，以心血炼器，求广结仙缘！[/p][p][/p][h3]【何为《壶中日月》？】[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45420082/5ef1245213820d98935d2c37566b04949e2aea30.png"][/img][/p][p]你意外穿越至乾坤日月壶，成为“史上最菜掌门”——灵脉被封、修为全无，却要带领三位弟子重建宗门。通过秘境探索、炼丹炼器、培养弟子渡劫飞升，逐步揭开壶中真相。[/p][p]“谁说掌门一定要会修仙？——赤璃”[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 《壶中日月 Timeless Teapot》Update Log V1.1.2
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Here are the main updates for version 1.1.2:  

**Main Content:**  
- Optimized the Celestial Workshop function (significantly reduced upgrade/ascension time, and now allows equipment upgrades/ascensions during battles).  
- Optimized the Forgotten River Collection function (added auto-purchase options for gold/red-quality items and a one-click "Buy All" button for current items).  
- Added auto-breakthrough (automatically breaks through to the highest achievable realm with 100% success rate).  
- Optimized character leveling (right-click to level up by 10/100/1000/max level).  
- Added one-click gem selling (gem auto-selling and equipment auto-selling are now separate options).  
- Improved the save file interface (manual and auto-saves are now in the same screen).  

**Bug Fixes:**  
- Fixed a bug where gems could be equipped.  
- Fixed a bug where excessively large numerical values caused data errors in later stages.  

**System Adjustments:**  
- Removed time restrictions for exiting stage battles.  
- Adjusted Yan Ke’s skill logic: increased single-instance damage but reduced activation frequency.  
- Added hover tooltips for Forgotten River Collection and Hero Recruitment buildings.  
- Reduced early-game monster difficulty.  
- Optimized in-game text descriptions.  

**Additional Notes:**  
If the game crashes or the process is forcibly closed during saving, the save file may become corrupted. A backup save folder (`saves_backup`) has been added to prevent cloud save loss. If the save is corrupted and prevents starting a new game, try the following:  
1. Enable Steam offline mode.  
2. Manually delete the corrupted save in the `saves` folder.  
3. Copy the backup save from `saves_backup` into the `saves` folder to attempt recovery.  

**Save File Location:**  
Press Win+R, type `AppData`, then navigate to:  
`\\\\LocalLow\\\\skyblack games\\\\Timeless Teapot\\\\userData\\\\saves`  

**Bug Reports & Feedback:**  
Join our Discord group: 1020655392  
Or email: [/p][p][url="https://skyblack7301@gmail.com"]skyblack7301@gmail.com[/url][/p][p]  

This game is independently developed in my spare time, and testing may be insufficient. If you encounter any bugs, please don’t hesitate to report them. Thank you for your support![/p]
